meta.title: Syracuse Budget Explorer
meta.scope: Formal adopted City fund totals, with the school district shown separately in the combined summary.
meta.sourceNote: The Auditor workbook supplies historical account detail. The adopted PDF supplies formal FY27 totals and final amendments.
meta.workbookCaveat: The Auditor notes that workbook figures can differ from the formal budget because of rounding or other errors.

narrative.label: The adopted plan adds aid
narrative.body: Temporary AIM state aid rises by $20.0M from the proposed workbook plan. The adopted PDF leaves a $879 fund-balance residual.

narrative.label: The General Fund grows
narrative.body: The adopted General Fund is $350.6M, up $17.6M, or 5.3%, from the FY26 adopted plan.

narrative.label: Final amendments matter
narrative.body: The final General Fund is $3.9M below the workbook's FY27 proposed plan after the listed amendments.

validation.label: Crouse-Marshall assessment revenue: detail versus formal
validation.detail: Detail $199,863.00; formal $181,863.00; difference $18,000.00. Detail uses workbook proposals and mapped amendments; it is not certified adopted account data. The $181,863 formal assessment excludes $18,000 of other program revenue. The workbook operating revenue and expense totals are both $199,863 (sheet rows 2, 9 and 35). These totals have different scopes.

validation.label: Downtown assessment revenue: detail versus formal
validation.detail: Detail $2,484,919.00; formal $1,411,892.00; difference $1,073,027.00. Detail uses workbook proposals and mapped amendments; it is not certified adopted account data. Scope and source discrepancies both apply: adopted PDF page 61 gives assessment $1,390,714 plus allowance $21,178 = $1,411,892; workbook K56 instead has $1,309,714, K58 $21,178, and K55 states $1,441,892. PDF page 227 also shows broader program spending $2,609,019 versus workbook detail $2,609,020. Do not treat workbook district detail as the adopted levy.

validation.detail: Detail $2,609,020.00; formal $1,411,892.00; difference $1,197,128.00. Detail uses workbook proposals and mapped amendments; it is not certified adopted account data. Scope and source discrepancies both apply: adopted PDF page 61 gives assessment $1,390,714 plus allowance $21,178 = $1,411,892; workbook K56 instead has $1,309,714, K58 $21,178, and K55 states $1,441,892. PDF page 227 also shows broader program spending $2,609,019 versus workbook detail $2,609,020. Do not treat workbook district detail as the adopted levy.
